pages.quiz:
WOODWORK — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: WOODWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Mass Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Mass Production.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Mass Production.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Mass Production.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Mass Production.

2. When learning Portable Power Tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Portable Power Tools.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Portable Power Tools.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Portable Power Tools.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Portable Power Tools.

3. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

4. When learning Manufactured boards, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Manufactured boards.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Manufactured boards.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Manufactured boards.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Manufactured boards.

5. When learning Orthographic Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Orthographic Drawing.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Orthographic Drawing.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Orthographic Drawing.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Orthographic Drawing.

6. When learning Health and Safety in the Workshop, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Health and Safety in the Workshop.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Health and Safety in the Workshop.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Health and Safety in the Workshop.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Health and Safety in the Workshop.

7. When learning Detailed drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Detailed drawing.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Detailed drawing.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Detailed drawing.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Detailed drawing.

8. When learning Finishing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Finishing.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Finishing.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Finishing.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Finishing.

9. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

10. When learning Project activity, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project activity.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Project activity.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project activity.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project activity.

11. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

12. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. Speaker
   C. Monitor
   D. CPU

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Timber Defects and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Manufactured boards and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Mass Production and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Finishing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Mass Production.

2. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Portable Power Tools.

3. D — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

4. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Manufactured boards.

5. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Orthographic Drawing.

6. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Health and Safety in the Workshop.

7. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Detailed drawing.

8. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Finishing.

9. A — Never touch live wires with wet hands

10. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project activity.

11. A — Information and Communication Technology

12. D — CPU

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Timber Defects; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
